title: CFEDR d2025 conventional H-mode — PCS command replay (DRAFT v0.1)
status: draft for PCS-W3 / ledger I-5 (2026-09-13); field names follow no agreed interface yet — PCS-W0 interface table pending
design_version: d2025 (104014/104007 official version, 15 MA). NOT d2026 20 MA (FYDOC-CASE-21); no CFETR values.
lcfs_convention: Miller parameters (r0, z0, a, kappa, delta_upper, delta_lower) as in code/discharge settings; COCOS 17; point lists [TBD] (PCS-G4)

interpolation.lcfs: linear per Miller parameter; configuration switches at the flagged node
interpolation.p_ec p_ic p_nbi p_lh: zero-order hold from a node's t until the next node

lcfs_rule: ramp-up (synthetic): a piecewise linear (1 s 1.9 m, 17 s 2.1 m, 60 s 2.45 m); kappa 1.1 to 5 s then linear to 1.90 at 60 s; delta_u/l 0.10 to 5 s then linear to 0.567/0.584 at 60 s; R0 = 5.12 m + a while HFS-limited (t < 17 s), then linear to 7.87 m at 60 s; z0 = 0

ec_rampup.rho_tor_norm: per node (0.36 for 10-30 s, 0.39 for 30-60 s)

ec_ntm.note: 28-69 MW at rho 0.6 for NTM control is outside the 102 MW and not scheduled here (tbl-r20-hcd)

flags: informational: the 1.5-D replay starts at t = 1 s (PCS-W5); Ip 0.5 MA here (control paper) is inconsistent with Ip 0.25 MA at 1 s (equilibrium paper) — two model families, not reconciled
